name: Multi Select
description: A filterable picker for several values, shown as removable pills.
usage:
<MultiSelect
  label="Project roles"
  options={[
    { value: 'admin', label: 'Administrator' },
    { value: 'editor', label: 'Editor' },
    { value: 'viewer', label: 'Viewer' },
  ]}
/>

anatomy.description: The combobox-role trigger that hosts the selected pills.
Removable tokens, one per value, each with its own labeled remove button.
The inline text input inside the open popup.
The multi-selectable option list with check marks on chosen rows.

dos: Show every selected value as a pill so removal stays one click away.
Let the pill row wrap instead of truncating selections.
Keep the popup open between picks so multi-selection stays fast.
donts: Don't use it when only one value is allowed; use Select or Combobox.
Don't collapse selections into a +N summary; the pills are the value.
Don't disable the whole control when only some options are unavailable.

examples.title: Multiple values
examples.description: Options toggle without closing; pills remove individual values.

examples.title: Filtering a label set
examples.description: A filterable label picker with a caller-owned value and one unavailable option.

guidance.useWhen: Users pick several values from a filterable list.
guidance.avoidWhen: Only one value is allowed; use Select or Combobox.
guidance.behavior: Options toggle without closing and pills remove through compact 24px touch targets.
guidance.responsive: Pills wrap inside the control as values accumulate.

keyboard.action: Opens the listbox from the control.
Filters the option list in the inline filter field.
Moves focus between the control, pill remove buttons, and the open listbox.

notes: The control uses combobox semantics with aria-expanded and a multi-selectable listbox popup.
Every pill has a remove button labeled Remove plus the option name.
Selected options keep a check mark and aria-selected in the list.

apiEntries.description:
Multi-value select: selected options render as removable pills inside the
control, and a filterable multi-select listbox toggles options without closing.
